name: spp-customization
label: Spp Customization
description: Spp Customization: a store layout with its own font, an announcement bar, a New badge on product cards, a hero block for the page builder and a welcome page.

headingFont.label: Heading font: brand (the theme's own Geist), family (Montserrat, from the parent theme) or system

logoUrl.label: Header logo for this store (image URL; empty: the store's own logo)

mobileHeaderHeight.label: Height of the store header on phones and tablets, in px (kept from the first paint so the page does not jump when the header switches to its phone layout; 0: no reserve)

supportPhone.label: Customer service phone, shown in the announcement bar (required)

showTrustStrip.label: Show the trust strip under the header

popularSearches.label: Popular searches under the search box (up to 5)

customizableSkus.label: Decorated products: SKUs whose add-to-cart becomes "Customize & order" (opens the customizer)

shipCutoffHour.label: Daily dispatch cutoff hour (0-23, warehouse time): orders before it ship the same weekday

brandName.label: Brand name for link previews and the home-screen app name (og:site_name, application-name)

siteVerification.label: Search console site verification code (google-site-verification); set per store

supportOpenHour.label: Customer service opens at this hour (0-23, weekdays, warehouse time)

supportCloseHour.label: Customer service closes at this hour (1-24, weekdays, warehouse time)

themeCards.label: Listings use the theme's product card (single-page listings; paged ones keep the store's)

noticeText.label: Dated notice above the header (holiday shipping, closures); empty: none
noticeText.default: Holiday shipping: order by Dec 17 for delivery before Dec 25. Our warehouse is closed Dec 24-26.

noticeFrom.label: Show the notice from (YYYY-MM-DD, warehouse time zone)

showBadge.label: Show the New badge on product cards
